fills.name: Hagl Brodda
fills.quote: 6 Hagl Broddax2 (Ranged) / 5.00 Tiles Range / 0.88s Attack Speed
fills.note: Read from a Veteran Archer's attack panel, not from the tech tooltip: secondary attack of 6 damage x2 projectiles
fills.tieReason: The stat panel at s_02410 shows a second attack line, '6 Hagl Brodda x2 (Ranged)', with 5.00 Tiles Range and 0.88s Attack Speed. The 'x2' is the number of extra arrows the tech adds. Each of those arrows does 6 damage. The tech's own effect is 'Archers fire two additional arrows at random when attacking' (official civ page, and vikings.json line 434). The Corvinus fill also records effectValue 2 for Hagl Brodda. So the headline effect value is 2. The 6 is the damage of each extra arrow, not the tech's effect value.
